title: Fear · node 1
text:
Fear has an address.

Node 1. The Lumbar Plexus. The low back and pelvis.

It governs instinct, threat. When it carries charge, the behaviour it makes cheap is avoidance.

Put a hand on the low back and pelvis. Bring fear to mind and hold it for ninety seconds. If the area warms, tightens, goes cold or starts to hum, that is the node answering.

Ninety seconds. You do not have to believe anything to run it.

title: Axis 01 · Fear to Safety
text:
Fear releases to Safety.

Presents as hypervigilance, doubt, lack of confidence, abandonment sensitivity, rejection sensitivity.

Dense soma breaks in fragments, not dissolves.

February 2025 release: Ascension confirmed mechanically at this address.

Address: Lumbar Plexus (L1-L4).

title: Axis 03 · Shame to Worth
text:
Shame releases to Worth.

The only emotion that removes volume from the system at once.

Goes cold, feels small, impulse to hide.

Release sequence: Sad → Deflated → Humiliated → Embarrassed → Guilty → Shame.

Address: Pudendal Nerve.

title: Axis 04 · Disgust to Acceptance
text:

text:

Distinct from Sadness at a distinct anatomical address.

Address: Center chest, bilateral, lung influence.

band: Inferior anterior cardiac nerves / Superficial cardiac plexus
title: Axis 09 · Sad to Happy
text:
Sad releases to Happy.

Sad was not discovered in May 2026.

The omission was discovered.

Happy had been listed without its pole.

Address: Inferior anterior cardiac nerves / Superficial cardiac plexus.

title: The iceberg model is wrong
text:
The familiar iceberg says what is above the water is known and what is below is hidden. That model has two zones.

The accurate model has four.

Known Knowns, above the water. Unknown Knowns, past the clouds, which cannot be conceptualised and have to be experienced. Known Unknowns, just below the surface, the shadow. Unknown Unknowns, in the depths, running in a nervous system you inherited.

The lens is the thing you cannot see, because you are looking through it and not at it.

title: Anger is not the problem
text:
Anger is power. The solar plexus is where power lives.

When it fires at the celiac plexus it is not a negative emotion misfiring. It is the system identifying a violation of the field and mobilising force to address it.

The problem is not that anger exists. The problem is that it runs on a trigger the person never chose.

Cleared, it becomes discernment rather than dominance.

title: Every charge has a rise and a fall
text:
The ascending side builds the primary node. The descending side produces the shame cluster. Humiliated, embarrassed, guilty, sad, deflated.

Those are not separate emotions. They are the same charge at different phases of one cycle.

Which is why the anger node cannot clear without the shame cluster that formed on the way down. Work the ascending nodes first. The rest releases with them.

title: Shame is the fastest one
text:
It is the only emotion that removes volume from the system at once. Not gradually. At once.

Goes cold. Feels small. The impulse is to hide.

You can watch it in a dog. Head drops, ears droop, tail goes between the legs, it limps away. Humans do the same thing with better emotional control.

Nobody comes in for shame. They come in for anger, anxiety, creative block. Shame is almost always underneath.

title: A loaded nerve feels different
text:
A clear nerve feels like an individual fibre. Free and smooth.

A loaded nerve feels trapped in volume. Like the nerve is buried in dense dirt.

The work is unearthing it. Not forcing it. Unearthing.

title: The plexus is hardware, the chakra is the field
text:
A nerve plexus is physical. Actual tissue. A place along the spine where fibres converge and branch.

When a plexus branches into three fibres it creates a field. That field is the chakra.

The plexus is the hardware. The chakra is what the hardware generates. Block the plexus and the field it generates gets disrupted.

title: A grudge is a poison pill
text:
Resentment is recycled anger running on a loop.

When you hold a grudge you take a poison pill. It fires the stress response every time you see the person, or think about them, or hear their name.

The grudge costs you. It does not cost them.

Address: suprarenal plexus, just above the kidney, back of the body.

title: Eight words down, one word up
text:
Count the emotion words you have for the shadow range. Sad, angry, scared, ashamed, disgusted, guilty, lonely, numb.

Now count the ones for the upward range. Happy.

Eight compression channels. One expansion channel. That asymmetry is itself diagnostic.

The work restores access to the expansion channel. Not by suppressing the eight, but by clearing the charge that keeps compression dominant.

title: A stranger at a party
text:
He looked puzzled a few feet away. I asked what was up.

His father. Health issues on top of old life issues. The man had been abusive, an alcoholic, and it had cut a rift going back to childhood. He had decided he did not want to help him. And at the same time it was his father and he wanted to help.

Weeks of wrestling with it.

The wound was not the anger. It was the toggle. His mind was flipping between two committed positions and the flipping itself was the freeze.

So I went at the resentment and told him the mechanic plainly. A grudge fires the stress response every time you see the person. It costs you, not him.

His spine straightened. He said he had been circling that for weeks and felt free.

A few minutes. The node cleared and the toggle stopped.

title: Thirty minutes in an underground bar
text:
Los Angeles. A courtyard. Someone I had never met, early thirties.

Within a few minutes he said he had always had this issue with his father, that it was the worst pain of his life, and he did not know how to solve it.

I asked him to describe it. He did. I saw the wound in real time.

I told him: you are angry at him, but what you are holding is shame. The anger is the surface. The shame is underneath. And I described the dynamic, where it was born, how it had been running in both directions for years without either of them seeing it.

He started laughing. He said I had just rocked his world.

That is the mechanic. Not the pattern. The identification with the pattern. The second the spell breaks, the energy sustaining it dissolves with it.

title: You look ten years younger
text:
After a two-hour session where rage, fear and anger released, two friends at dinner within the month said the same thing independently.

Not metaphor. The stress response ages everything. It deprives cells, tissues, organs. It constricts flow. You can see it from outside as grey hair, balding, poor vision, nerve function loss.

When it releases: tension gone, pressure gone, the thoughts around it gone, the darkness that compressed it gone.

title: What is proven and what is not
text:
Stated plainly, because this category usually does not.

Proven and public. Co-authored peer-reviewed work with a gastroenterologist in Endoscopy, Thieme. DOI 10.1055/a-2013-1820.

Documented in the literature. The body emits ultraweak photon radiation, measurable with photomultiplier tubes, documented since the 1920s.

Observed, not formally studied. Most of the specific mechanisms here. Fifteen thousand releases run on myself over five years, six thousand recorded.

Does not exist yet. Controlled trials. Three credentialed physicians have reviewed this work and recommended them. Nobody has run them.

I would rather you knew the shape of that.
